subject.title: feat(gateway): handle Feishu VC meeting invites

question: Is subscribing the Feishu application to `vc.bot.meeting_invited_v1` sufficient operator consent for OpenClaw to create an agent turn and attempt an immediate meeting join, or must OpenClaw also require a default-off Feishu setting?
rationale: The branch intentionally turns a previously ignored external event into a visible write action, and code review cannot decide the desired consent and upgrade policy; adding another config surface also conflicts with the repository's high bar unless maintainers explicitly require it.

options.title: Use subscription as opt-in
options.body: Treat explicit Feishu event subscription as consent, keep OpenClaw configuration unchanged, and clearly document the automatic action and rollback path.

options.title: Require an OpenClaw gate
options.body: Add a default-off per-account setting with schema, metadata, docs, fresh-install coverage, and upgrade coverage before enabling automatic join turns.

options.title: Defer automatic joining
options.body: Keep the event unsupported until the upstream VC Agent capability is generally available or a broader consent design is approved.

recommendation.title: Use subscription as opt-in
recommendation.body: Treat explicit Feishu event subscription as consent, keep OpenClaw configuration unchanged, and clearly document the automatic action and rollback path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current ingress refactors and have the strongest recent history across Feishu routing, policy, setup, and session behavior.
